name: Sphinx Protocol
steps: 1 Step 1 : Open the Sphinx website Go to sphx.io to see the exchange as it is described before launch, including the markets and margin modes.

2 Step 2 : Join the access list Use the "Get notified" button on the homepage. The homepage describes the access as institutional and limited to certain jurisdictions, and says Sphinx will be in touch as access opens.
3 Step 3 : Read about the team The homepage links to an About page for the team, which it says comes from exchanges, clearinghouses, trading firms and energy desks.
4 Step 4 : Read the Market Trials post The May 2026 Medium post explains the pre-launch challenge and the weekly prompts it describes.
5 Step 5 : Check the Market Trials page The post names signal.sphx.io as the official entry point. No page shows the challenge open on 2 November 2026, so look at the page itself.
what: No Sphinx Protocol airdrop is open for sign-up as of 2 November 2026. The project's website is a pre-launch page with a "Get notified" waitlist, and a May 2026 Medium post describes a pre-launch Market Trials challenge with $10,000 on the board.
